en: What you ask Shiori goes to the model provider you connect, with what she needs from your trip, and what you say goes where Settings → Voice shows. Places she looks up go to the sources credited in Settings → About. The Trace shows every request annai sends for Shiori: her model calls, her tools and the offline pack.

en: Each model key is kept in this device's storage and sent only to the provider it is for. Keys are never put in what Shiori's model reads, are blanked out of the Trace, and are left out of exports, unless you choose to put them in an encrypted backup.

en: annai has no analytics and no ads. It loads no scripts from other sites: its content security policy lets only scripts from annai's own address run, except code plugins you install, which annai stores and serves itself.
text: annai 没有统计分析，也没有广告。它不从其他网站加载脚本：内容安全策略只允许运行来自 annai 自己地址的脚本，你安装的代码插件除外，它们由 annai 自己存储和提供。

en: With notifications on, the push relay holds each time reminder encrypted on this device, and keeps only the phone's push address, when each is due, how many are waiting, and little else: a cancel code for each, and a note that this phone has received one. Reminders about places never leave the phone.

en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. Exa also reads a page that no other reader can, which sends it that page's address. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches. Behind them, a last resort that is always on asks Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) the same words; only Search via: Off stops it.
text: 免费搜索会把你的搜索发送给 Exa、Parallel 或 Firecrawl：只发送搜索的词，不发送你的文件或位置。Exa 还会读取其他方式读不了的网页，因此也会收到该网页的地址。它们都是可能变化或停止的免费额度，而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜索内容训练模型，所以请不要在搜索中写名字和地址。在它们之后，还有一个始终开启的最后手段，会用同样的词询问 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）；只有“搜索方式：关闭”能停止它。
note: Note: "Search via: Off" as the choice is named on this screen.

en: Only the words she searches for go to the ones you leave ticked, and Exa also gets the addresses of pages it reads for her: not your files or your location. They're free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use searches to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of them. Behind them, Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) are always asked as a last resort; only Settings → Tools → Search via: Off stops that. You can change all this there.
